::: {.hero}
# Jesús Crespo Cuaresma

**Professor of Economics · Vienna University of Economics and Business**  
Head of the Department of Economics

I am an economist working on econometric methods and their application to questions in macroeconomics, demographic change, climate change and human mobility. A central theme of my research is the development of quantitative tools for studying long-run socioeconomic change under model uncertainty.

[Email](mailto:jcrespo@wu.ac.at){.btn .btn-primary} [WU profile](https://www.wu.ac.at/en/economics/people/crespo-j){.btn} [Research database](https://research.wu.ac.at/en/persons/jesus-crespo-cuaresma-3/){.btn} [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-3244-6560){.btn}
:::

## Research

::: {.theme-grid}
::: {.theme-card}
### Econometric methods & forecasting
Methods for model uncertainty, structural change, spatial and international interdependencies, and forecast combination.

[Research →](research.qmd#econometric-methods-and-forecasting)
:::

::: {.theme-card}
### Demography & long-run development
The role of education, human capital and demographic change in economic growth and long-run socioeconomic projections.

[Research →](research.qmd#demography-human-capital-and-long-run-development)
:::

::: {.theme-card}
### Climate, environment & human mobility
Quantitative modelling of environmental shocks, greenhouse-gas emissions, vulnerability and migration responses.

[Research →](research.qmd#climate-environment-and-human-mobility)
:::
:::
